fixture_note: Portable hand-authored demo catalog matching the real schema_version=1 Office catalog fields (item_id/asin/title/brand/price_usd/categories/features/description/technical_details). The cluster run passes the full Office catalog via --catalog.
disclaimer_zh: 本地采购草稿，不下单、不扣款 / 商品来源见需求简报；库存与变更为演示服务
disclaimer_en: Local draft only. No order is placed and no payment is taken. Items come from a historical catalog; stock and changes are simulated by the demo service.
description: Five fixed acceptance cases. The same deterministic policy is used by the HTTP API and by tests/test_shopping_flow.py.

cases.label_zh: 正常确认 + 幂等 + 重启可读
cases.step: research -> approve the proposal -> approve the same proposal again
cases.expect: first approve writes one durable draft reservation with a verified readback; the repeated approve returns the same reservation_id and writes nothing new; reopening the DB still shows the reservation

cases.step: research -> reject the proposal -> attempt approve
cases.expect: rejection is recorded, no reservation row exists, a later approve is refused with 409 proposal_rejected
no recommendation and no proposal; deterministic negotiation options are returned; no reservation is created

cases.label_zh: 提案后报价变化被拦截
cases.label_en: Price changed after proposal is blocked
cases.step: research -> 模拟报价变化 -> attempt approve
cases.expect: proposal moves to NEEDS_REVIEW; approve is refused with 409 quote_changed and asks for replan; no reservation and no automatic re-approval

cases.step: research -> advance the injected clock past expires_at -> attempt approve
cases.expect: approve is refused with 409 proposal_expired; no reservation is created. Covered by unittest via an injected clock (no sleeps).
